_note: TEACHES THE AGE LADDER. Won by reaching age 2, the Age of Embers.
ONE ROW, AND IT NAMES NO id. `subject: age` counts nothing on the map -- it reads
SimPlayer.age -- so an id here would be meaningless and the loader refuses one rather
THE VALUE IS THE AGE INDEX, NOT A COST. Ages are indexed from 1 (SimPlayer.age starts
there), so `>= 2` is 'has advanced once'. ages.json names age 2 'Age of Embers II';
advancing costs resources and then runs on a timer with a HUD ring, so this scenario
is really about affording it -- which is why it comes after the economy lesson and not
STARTS AT AGE 1 for the obvious reason: a scenario about advancing an age cannot start
in the age it is asking you to reach. `starting_age` is one number for everybody, so
the passive opponent starts there too.
name: How To Age Up
description: A new age unlocks better buildings and better units. Gather enough to advance from the Age of Ash into the Age of Embers.
message:
Tap your town centre and choose ADVANCE AGE. It costs resources and then takes time -- the ring on your age badge shows how long is left.

Goal: reach the Age of Embers.

objectives.subject: age
objectives.text: Advance to the Age of Embers
